doc: Who labelled and reviewed the topic labels (#220). Every reviewer here is an agent (a subagent prompted to act as the role given), not a person; the owner reviews the labels later. The ids are what a label's `by` names. scripts/topic-agents.mjs prompts each with its role; scripts/build-topic-labels.mjs copies this into the labels file.

zh.attribution: Topic labels for Chinese words, written for qinqin (qinqin contributors, CC BY 4.0): topics suggested by an agent from the CC-CEDICT senses and the word's OpenMoji picture, then reviewed by agents acting as teachers of Chinese. Not yet reviewed by a person.

reviewers.role: An experienced lexicographer and teacher of Chinese who labels each word with topics from the list, using its CC-CEDICT senses and the topic of its OpenMoji picture as a hint.
A native Mandarin speaker from Beijing who has taught Chinese to adult learners for fifteen years and prepares students for the HSK.
A native Mandarin speaker from Shanghai who teaches Chinese at a university language centre and writes theme-based course units for beginners and intermediate learners.
A native Mandarin speaker who heads a Chinese-as-a-foreign-language department and designs curricula; decides where the two teachers disagree.

ja.attribution: Topic labels for Japanese words, written for qinqin (qinqin contributors, CC BY 4.0): topics suggested by an agent from the JMdict senses and the word's OpenMoji picture, then reviewed by agents acting as teachers of Japanese. Not yet reviewed by a person.

reviewers.role: An experienced lexicographer and teacher of Japanese who labels each word with topics from the list, using its JMdict senses and the topic of its OpenMoji picture as a hint.
A native Japanese speaker from Tokyo who has taught Japanese to adult learners for fifteen years and prepares students for the JLPT N5 to N3.
A native Japanese speaker from Osaka who teaches at a Japanese-language school (日本語学校) and writes theme-based lesson plans for beginners and intermediate learners.
A native Japanese speaker who leads the curriculum of a Japanese-language school; decides where the two teachers disagree.
